text: Whatever you do... don't look at his face.
SCP-096. Over two meters tall. Pale. Arms longer than your whole body.
Most days, he just paces in a steel cube. No cameras allowed.
Because if you see his face... even in a photo...
He covers it with his hands. And he starts screaming.
A minute later... he starts running.
Walls don't stop him. Distance doesn't matter. He always knows where you are.
You're scrolling late at night. A blurry photo. Something pale.
Far away... something starts to scream.
But that photo... wasn't a drawing.
